entities.summary: Takizawa Bakin , born Takizawa Okikuni , was a Japanese novelist of the Edo period, who wrote under the pen name Kyokutei Bakin . Later in life he took the pen name Toku (解). Modern scholarship generally refers to him as Kyokutei Bakin, or just as Bakin. He is regarded as one of, if not the, leading author of early 19th century Japanese literature. He was the third surviving son of a samurai family of low rank. After numerous deaths in his family, he relinquished his samurai status, married a merchant's widow, and became an Edo townsperson.
